entities.name: Windy Cantika Aisah
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Windy Cantika Aisah is an Indonesian weightlifter. She won the gold medal at the 2019 SEA Games and the bronze medal at the 2020 Summer Olympics in the women's 49 kg event.
